user.title: Paperless-ngx Insights
user.description: Connect Paperless. By default, only Home Assistant administrators can access documents. The optional browser address is used for links to the Paperless interface.

reconfigure.title: Change connection
reconfigure.description: Leave the token blank to retain the current API token. New credentials are checked before saving. Changing the Paperless address or token removes user sharing for this connection.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew API token
reauth_confirm.description: Changing the Paperless address or token removes user sharing for this connection.

error.forbidden: The Paperless user cannot read documents.
error.cannot_connect: Paperless is unreachable or temporarily busy.
error.invalid_response: The response does not match the expected Paperless API.

abort.already_configured: This Paperless server is already configured.

init.title: Document access
init.description: Share this connection with selected Home Assistant users. They can search, preview and download every document the configured Paperless account can read. Leave the list empty for administrators only.

error.invalid_user: Select active Home Assistant users from the list.

abort.access_settings_changed: The connection or its permissions changed. Open Document access again.
